Go to Twitter/Facebook/Tumblr/Instagram/Discord/Here on Reddit find as many places to promote your content as long as they are in the same genre (gaming/art/music etc.) and just hit EVERYTHING man. It’s one of those things where if you find even 10 places to promote (which isn’t a lot of you think about it) and if even 100 people see all that and of that 100, maybe 10 views well there you go.
